history.recommendation_text: The Board recommends that the Administration maintain a central list of all bank reconciliation opening items older than three months, as well as work with local bank reconcilers and the Treasury to identify process changes that would improve the clearing period of old open reconciling items.
history.administration_response: The Administration is collecting and compiling a list of items that are older than three months. In addition, it is meeting regularly with reconcilers of accounts that have long-open items. The list, which is centrally maintained, helps to identify common reconciling/clearing issues so that process improvements can be identified and improvements in processes made, where needed. As a result of improvements in monitoring, when looking at the number of open items as at the end of June and December 2023, the total number of open items decreased by 32 per cent and the total number of items older than three months decreased by 37 per cent.
history.board_assessment: A central list of all bank opening items older than three months was provided at 2023/24 year end. The Board therefore considers the recommendation to be implemented.
